title: TODO marker on a layout object
description:
Unfinished-work rule — a layout object carries a TODO marker (TODO, TO DO, TO-DO, TBD, to be done, to be defined) in its text content (static text or button label), tooltip, label or title calculation. A TODO describes planned work, not a defect, so the severity is info: the rule counts with its own figure but never turns the traffic light yellow. The defect half of the family is layout_text_fixme.

Based on the fmCheckMate check "FIXME" — https://github.com/mrwatson-de/fmCheckMate-XSLT
author: fm-lab rules

rule.rationale: A TODO on a layout object records work that was planned and postponed. It is a stock figure — but one that sits on the user interface, so it can end up on screen and in print even though it is not a defect.
rule.remediation: Nothing to fix per finding. Check whether the marker is visible to users; if it is, move the note into the object comment and keep the canvas clean.

meta.name: TODO marker on a layout object
meta.author: fm-lab rules
meta.description: Unfinished-work rule — a layout object carries a TODO marker in its text content (static text or button label), tooltip, label or title calculation. Detector canon of the family: (?i)(\bto[\s\-_]?do|\btbd\b|\bto[\s\-_]be[\s\-_](done|defined)\b), verified by tools/tests/rules/unfinished_work_detector.sql; the family deliberately omits the trailing word boundary so plural markers ("TO DOs") still match. Deliberate deviation from the source rule, which matches case-sensitively without separator tolerance and therefore misses a text object reading "TO DO". Overlap with layout_text_fixme is intended.
